Beach Investment Counsel Upped Its Apple Computer (AAPL) Position; Last Week Allegiance Bancshares, Inc. (ABTX) Analysts 
April 21, 2018 - By Henry Gaston 
Beach Investment Counsel Inc increased Apple Computer (AAPL) stake by 24.59% reported in 2017Q4 SEC filing. Beach Investment Counsel Inc acquired 37,732 shares as Apple Computer (AAPL)’s stock declined 3.81%. The Beach Investment Counsel Inc holds 191,181 shares with $32.35 million value, up from 153,449 last quarter. Apple Computer now has $840.87B valuation. The stock decreased 4.10% or $7.08 during the last trading session, reaching $165.72. About 60.26M shares traded or 56.69% up from the average. Apple Inc. (NASDAQ:AAPL) has risen 19.49% since April 21, 2017 and is uptrending. It has outperformed by 7.94% the S&P500. 
Among 2 analysts covering Allegiance Bancshares ( NASDAQ:ABTX ), 1 have Buy rating, 0 Sell and 1 Hold. Therefore 50% are positive. Allegiance Bancshares had 6 analyst reports since November 2, 2015 according to SRatingsIntel. The rating was downgraded by Robert W. Baird to “Neutral” on Wednesday, September 21. The firm earned “Hold” rating on Monday, November 2 by Sandler O’Neill. The firm has “Market Perform” rating given on Wednesday, November 4 by Keefe Bruyette & Woods. The stock has “Outperform” rating by Robert W. Baird on Monday, November 2. Robert W. Baird upgraded it to “Outperform” rating and $39 target in Tuesday, December 13 report. The stock increased 0.12% or $0.05 during the last trading session, reaching $40.95. About 20,089 shares traded. Allegiance Bancshares, Inc. (NASDAQ:ABTX) has risen 12.29% since April 21, 2017 and is uptrending. It has outperformed by 0.74% the S&P500. 
Allegiance Bancshares, Inc. operates as the bank holding firm for Allegiance Bank that provides a range of commercial banking services primarily to small and medium-sized businesses, professionals, and individual customers. The company has market cap of $544.01 million. It accepts deposit products, including checking accounts, commercial accounts, savings accounts, and other time deposits comprising money market accounts and certificates of deposit. It has a 31.26 P/E ratio. The firm also grants various loan products, such as commercial and industrial loans; mortgage warehouse loans; commercial real estate loans, including multi-family residential loans; commercial real estate construction and land development loans; residential real estate loans, such as 1-4 family residential mortgage loans; residential construction loans; and consumer and other loans. 
Beach Investment Counsel Inc decreased Home Depot (NYSE:HD) stake by 2,590 shares to 65,426 valued at $12.40M in 2017Q4. It also reduced Visa (NYSE:V) stake by 4,360 shares and now owns 139,329 shares. Microsoft (NASDAQ:MSFT) was reduced too. 
Among 54 analysts covering Apple Inc. ( NASDAQ:AAPL ), 35 have Buy rating, 1 Sell and 18 Hold. Therefore 65% are positive. The rating was maintained by Guggenheim with “Buy” on Friday, August 11. The company was maintained on Thursday, September 7 by KeyBanc Capital Markets. The firm has “Perform” rating by Oppenheimer given on Wednesday, April 27. The firm has “Buy”rating by Stifel Nicolaus given on Wednesday, October 28. Longbow initiated the shares of AAPL in report on Wednesday, July 6 with “Buy” rating. FBN Securities maintained Apple Inc. (NASDAQ:AAPL) on Wednesday, April 27 with “Outperform” rating. The stock has “Market Perform” rating by Cowen & Co on Friday, January 8. The stock of Apple Inc. (NASDAQ:AAPL) has “Overweight” rating given on Wednesday, April 27 by Piper Jaffray. The stock has “Buy” rating by Nomura on Friday, March 24.
